rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Recently, the rations have
been getting stricter.

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0002
rows.name:
We pretty much just eat Purana
morning and night, you know?

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I tell you what, I'd love to eat a
bucketload of that Fleur Bavarois.

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I bet nobles eat it nearly every
day...

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0005
rows.name:
But I've got a secret plan: catch a
Speckled Whalefish and strike it rich!

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0006
rows.name: I'll leave this rationed life behind!

rows.label: tlk43100246_03_msg0007
rows.name:
But all I ever catch
is Bipedal Crabs...
